gloss: profile; side view of a face

definitions.gloss: profile; side view of a face
definitions.explanation: The appearance of a person's face as seen from the side.
A less well-known side or aspect of a person, organization, or thing. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{横顔|よこがお}が{美|うつく}しい。
{窓|まど}の{外|そと}を{見|み}ている{彼|かれ}の{横顔|よこがお}を{描|えが}いた。
examples.english: I drew his profile as he looked out the window.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{隣|となり}の{人|ひと}の{横顔|よこがお}がふと{目|め}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: On the train, the profile of the person next to me suddenly caught my eye.

examples.japanese: {都市|とし}の{知|し}られざる{横顔|よこがお}を{紹介|しょうかい}する。
examples.english: We introduce a lesser-known side of the city.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}の{横顔|よこがお}を{特集|とくしゅう}した{記事|きじ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read an article featuring the different sides of the company.

examples.japanese: この{番組|ばんぐみ}では{選手|せんしゅ}たちの{意外|いがい}な{横顔|よこがお}に{迫|せま}る。
examples.english: This program explores the surprising other sides of the athletes.

notes:
{横顔|よこがお} literally means the side view of a face, in contrast to {正面|しょうめん} (front view). It also has a common figurative use.

SENSE 1 — PROFILE:
Often used in aesthetic or romantic contexts to describe an attractive profile. Common collocations:
- {横顔|よこがお}が{美|うつく}しい: to have a beautiful profile
- {横顔|よこがお}を{見|み}つめる: to gaze at someone's profile
- {横顔|よこがお}を{描|えが}く: to draw a profile

SENSE 2 — ANOTHER SIDE:
Figuratively, a lesser-known aspect of a person, organization, or place. Common in journalism and documentary writing:
- {知|し}られざる{横顔|よこがお}: an unknown side
- {意外|いがい}な{横顔|よこがお}: a surprising aspect
- {企業|きぎょう}の{横顔|よこがお}: the profile of a company

FORMS:
{横|よこ} (side) + {顔|かお} (face). Note the rendaku: かお → がお.
